properties.name: hormuz_narrow_strait
properties.name_zh: 霍尔木兹海峡最窄商业通航段
properties.description: Nested sensitivity AOI: the geographically narrow commercial transit section of the Strait of Hormuz, defined as the fixed bounding box 56.25-56.65 E, 26.35-26.70 N (EPSG:4326, lon/lat).
properties.notes: This geometry is fixed before examining any matching-rate effect and must not be reshaped to maximise an event signal. It is nested inside the primary hormuz_core AOI. Purpose: raise per-scene coverage (a single Sentinel-1 IW scene fully covers this box), so that the acute-shock phase has more usable scenes than the primary AOI allows.
